response.sql:
WITH per_scope AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  JOIN users AS u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  avg_net_rate,
  fee_record_count,
  avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_average
FROM per_scope;

assumptions.assumption: The plain average is the unweighted average of per-scope averages, with each scope represented once; SQL AVG ignores NULL net rates when calculating both averages.
